wu: Hello Ball Toss: Students stand in a circle, toss a soft ball, and say 'Hello, my name is...' when they catch it. Teacher models first, then students introduce themselves.
wuAlt: Hello Puppet Show: Teacher uses a puppet to greet students, who respond with 'Hello, my name is...'.
Name Chain: First student says 'Hello, I am [name]', next student repeats and adds their own name.
pres: Teacher uses flashcards of 'stand up', 'sit down', 'look', 'listen' to demonstrate actions with exaggerated movements. Models 'Stand up!' and students repeat and stand. Checks understanding with 'What do I say?' and gestures.
presAlt: Classroom Rules Story: Teacher draws a simple story on the board of a student following rules, saying 'Look, listen, sit down.'
TPR Command Game: Teacher performs actions and says commands, then asks students to copy and say the words.
prac: Simon Says: Teacher says 'Simon says stand up/sit down/look/listen'. Students only move when 'Simon says' is included. Teacher monitors and corrects pronunciation.
pracAlt: Command Relay: Teams line up, first student runs to board, points to a command flashcard, and says it. Team earns points for correct actions.
Action Charades: Student draws a command flashcard, acts it out without speaking, and classmates guess the word.
ls: Listen and Draw: Teacher says 'Stand up and look at the board' or 'Sit down and listen to me'. Students draw simple pictures to show they understood the sequence of 3 instructions.
re: Freeze Dance: Play music, students dance on 'stand up', freeze on 'sit down'. Teacher calls commands randomly to reactivate vocabulary.
prod: Mini-Survey: Students walk around with a paper asking 'What is your name?' and 'Can you stand up/sit down?'. They write 3 friends' names and report back: 'Ali can stand up.'
rw: Trace and Copy: Students trace dotted words 'stand up', 'sit down', 'look' on a worksheet, then copy them neatly. Teacher checks for correct spelling and formation.
st: Goodbye Song: Sing 'Goodbye, Goodbye' with actions (wave, clap, stomp). End with a sticker chart where students put a sticker next to their name, then line up for high-fives.
g: Toss ball and say 'Hello, my name is...' to a partner.
Teacher says commands, students only move when 'Simon says' is included.
Teams race to point to flashcards and say commands correctly.
Dance on 'stand up', freeze on 'sit down' when music stops.
Ask 3 friends their name and if they can do actions, then report.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a short sentence 'My name is __. I can stand up.' with a drawing.
Support: Use picture flashcards alongside command words for visual cues.
hw: Teach 'stand up', 'sit down', 'look' to a family member and show them the actions.
Draw a picture of yourself following one classroom rule and write the word.
Practice the 'Hello' song with a sibling and perform it for the class next week.
tip: Use exaggerated gestures and facial expressions for TPR commands to ensure comprehension, especially for shy learners in a large group.
